# pcd_identity_federation_protocol (Resource)

Manages a Keystone federation protocol: the link between an identity provider and the mapping that turns its assertions into local users and groups. PCD single sign-on signs users in through a protocol named `saml2`, and no other: without it, sign-in fails even when the identity provider and the SSO configuration are right. The PCD UI creates it when the first SAML group is saved.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# PCD signs users in through the identity provider's saml2 protocol, which
# applies the mapping. In a configuration that also manages them, reference
# the pcd_identity_federation_identity_provider and
# pcd_identity_federation_mapping names instead, so they are created first.
resource "pcd_identity_federation_protocol" "saml2" {
  identity_provider = "IDP1"
  name              = "saml2"
  mapping_id        = "idp1_mapping"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity_provider` (String) The identity provider's name. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `mapping_id` (String) The name of the mapping the protocol applies. Keystone refuses a mapping that does not exist, so reference a `pcd_identity_federation_mapping`. Updated in place.
- `name` (String) The protocol's ID. PCD single sign-on uses `saml2`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<identity_provider>/<name>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax. The IDs are assigned by PCD; the
[Importing guide](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/platform9/pcd/latest/docs/guides/importing)
explains how to look them up.

```shell
# <identity_provider>/<protocol>: pcdctl federation protocol list --identity-provider IDP1
terraform import pcd_identity_federation_protocol.saml2 IDP1/saml2
```
